Manage necessary cookies and optional homepage analytics.
Signing in starts a session using a necessary cookie.
It does not change your analytics choice.
Optional measurement of visits to the homepage.
Change or withdraw your choice here. Privacy notice →
Settings are explicit choices, not switches. Sign-in never grants analytics consent automatically.
Manage clients, deals, projects, and revenue
Manage companies, leads, and customer information.
Full-access layout. Navigation and actions depend on permissions; demo writes are blocked.
Search by company, contact, email, phone, or location...
Row actions: View · menu → Edit / Archive · Request archive (when permitted).
Archiving can be blocked by related active records. Request archive is a separate approval workflow.
Native editable dialog states. Create and edit share a form; Details is read-only. Empty fields represent user input.
Save / Cancel / Close → return to Clients list

Type the exact record name to confirm

I understand this cannot be undone

Manage clients, deals, projects, and revenue
Track your requests and review assigned team requests.
Full-access layout. Navigation and actions depend on permissions; demo writes are blocked.
Reason for archiving · Requested by: Account name
Decision by: Reviewer · Reason: Decision text
Own pending requests: Cancel. Assigned pending requests: Approve / Reject. Final cards include decision details.
The record stays active until another
Related records are not archived automatically.
Submit → pending request. Another reviewer approves or rejects.
Cancel / reject / expiry leave the original record active.
Manage clients, deals, projects, and revenue
Individual accounts for one company. Select the sections and actions each person may use.
Full-access layout. Navigation and actions depend on permissions; demo writes are blocked.
Managers manage the employee accounts they create. Reserved and existing admin
accounts are not editable here. Archive request and direct archive permissions are independent.
Password: at least 12 characters. Email is locked when editing.
Save / Cancel → Users list. Role, account status and delegated permissions are edited here.

Manage company details and your personal dashboard preferences.
Full-access layout. Navigation and actions depend on permissions; demo writes are blocked.
Sign out of InsightBoard on this device.
Your theme preference is saved in this browser.
Company settings: admin only, outside demo mode. Account identity is read-only. Sign out returns to the landing page.
Standalone error pages and authenticated session states
Oops! This page took a wrong turn.
Continue the session explicitly before expiry. Verification failures offer a manual retry.
Session expiry → /login?reason=session-expired. Sign out → /. Missing identity → /login. Recovery destinations are fixed.
500 → Try again / Homepage · session expiry → Login
We use cookies for sign-in and to remember your settings. With your permission,
Vercel Web Analytics measures visits to this homepage. Analytics stays off until allowed.
Bottom banner stays fixed while scrolling. Closing × saves necessary-only. A saved choice hides the initial banner.
Overlay and menu variants use the same public page.
Compact navigation, lists, forms and public pages
Representative mobile layout. Long forms become one column; dialogs scroll; tables/cards follow each module implementation.
Reject / cancel / expiry → original record stays active
Actions shown for a permitted account. Demo mutations remain blocked.
All elements, screen groups and arrows are editable.
Based on the current InsightBoard source. Screen values and image areas are placeholders. Public Arabic pages use the same structure with RTL direction.
